utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll point you to the items as folks arrive, and we’ll keep things organized at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo — thank you. I’ll keep a clear list and send you to the first repairs when people start arriving Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — we’re set on tools, and it’ll help to have everyone there Saturday around 9 for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll spread the word that it’s Saturday around 9. If I hear a drop-off spot, I’ll pass it along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — that would be really helpful. If you hear a drop-off spot, let me know and I’ll pass it on too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Sunday at the community center, thanks. I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira. I’ll keep sharing the Sunday details too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when are we heading out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check who still needs help and what supplies we’re short on, then I’ll let everyone know the time. Sounds like we’re almost ready to head out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, keep me posted on the time and I’ll be ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks—just wanted to confirm. So you’re covering the school side and checking on Leo’s piece too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that’s right—I can handle the school schedule side, and I’ll check in with Leo about his part too. Saturday at 9 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. So we’re still starting the donation sorting at 9 on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still nudging folks to share broken items and repair skills, and we should lock in the pickup time and a clear count soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good — once we have the count, can you confirm the pickup time too? I’m just trying to make sure the corner lot logistics stay smooth.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the pickup time and keep pushing for a clear count so the corner lot stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on my way to the corner lot now, and I’ll help get everything loaded up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Sam — I’ll pass along any updates I catch about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — appreciate it. I’m headed to the corner lot now and ready to help load up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—I'm still trying to keep the repair drive moving along. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Oren — I really appreciate you keeping it moving. If you hear of any tape, nails, or a screwdriver, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for tape, nails, or a screwdriver and let you know if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anyone reaches out for help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Uli — I’m glad you’ll be there Sunday. I’ll keep telling the neighbors and let you know if anyone needs help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We could use a wrench, screwdriver, and someone to help carry supplies. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that works for me — I can help carry supplies. I’ll bring a wrench and screwdriver too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Hana — I’ll see you at the community shed at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but it sounds like they may need more volunteers. Do you know if there’s anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: If you can, bring tape, nails, or a screwdriver — those were mentioned as especially helpful. I’m still keeping track of where everything’s headed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for tape, nails, or a screwdriver and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring the wrench set and screwdriver by soon for the repair drive. If you need any gloves or a hammer too, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Gus — we’re covered on the tools then. I’ll keep the tape and nails ready in case anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, sounds good — I’ll drop off the wrench set and screwdriver soon. Just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good, but do we have the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded? I just want to make sure the repair drive stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have the pickup time or exact count yet, but I’ll check and get that sorted. We can keep the list tight and use the community center Sunday as our base.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — that helps. Please let me know the pickup time and updated count when you have it so I can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s mostly broken household items—small stuff people can bring in for repair. If you have a repair skill, that helps too; the drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ve got the list now. I’ll bring a screwdriver set and wood glue for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds great—I’ll keep letting folks know about the repair drive and send anyone who needs help your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep it quiet and send along any drop-off spot if I hear one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll keep spreading the word quietly and pass along any neighbors who need help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—Saturday morning around 9 works for me. Just let me know where we’re meeting for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — let’s meet at my place on Maple around 9, and I’ll bring the wrench set and screwdriver for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll be there at your place on Maple at 9. Thanks for bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s getting underway—do you still need more volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, we could still use a few more volunteers, and any donated supplies would help too. Thanks for keeping an ear out, Nell.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, I’ll keep passing it along and watch for anyone with extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, tape, and spare nails ready for the repair drive. If anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. I’ll swing by and grab them, and if I think of anything else I still need, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane—just stop by when you can and I’ll hand them over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? I can help work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll pass along any timing updates as soon as I hear them. Thanks for helping work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just keep me posted, and I’ll make sure it fits around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Noah — I’ll be at the community center Sunday and can help whenever you get there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll pass along any updates I catch about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate that. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Opal, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — we’re still on for today, and I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive spot in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I come by, and do you still need any tools or help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam — I’ve got the repair stuff and I’ll meet you at the corner lot in about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — I’ll be at the corner lot and help load everything up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — see you at the corner lot in about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — with Gus bringing the wrench set and screwdriver, and Leo helping Saturday around 9, we should be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear — sounds like things are coming together nicely. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you keeping an ear out. Let me know if you hear anything helpful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just tell me the first thing that needs fixing, and keep me posted if the repair drive spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm—are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—just point me to the first fix, and I’m in. A quick heads-up if the location changes is perfect.
